question: In Box: Add the tag ready-for-review to the folder in the Legal Archive that holds more than 800 MB of files, has a shared link open to anyone, and was modified after August 15, 2026. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked the **Legal Archive** folder and its two subfolders against all three criteria:

| Folder | Size | Shared link | Modified |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Discovery Prior Release** | 820 MB ✅ | Open to anyone ✅ | 2026-03-02 ❌ |
| **Discovery Working Notes** | 30 MB ❌ | None ❌ | 2026-08-21 ✅ |

No folder matches all three conditions — so I didn't tag anything.

- **Discovery Prior Release** clears the size and open shared link bars, but its last modification was March 2, 2026, well before August 15.
- **Discovery Working Notes** was modified after August 15, but it's only 30 MB and has no shared link.

If the date cutoff was meant differently (e.g., *before* August 15, or "any time in 2026"), Discovery Prior Release would be the candidate — just say the word and I'll add the `ready-for-review` tag.
